text:
maria: quick heads-up — saw a regression on the host-side grpc streaming path after the mini-write changes. p50 up ~8ms, p99 up ~45ms for short prompts. attaching quick profiler snips below.
ben: saw this on my canary too. short requests are worst hit.
kai: any change to kernel selection or batching heuristics in that PR?
maria: PR swapped to the new minibatch hinting: batching.min_tokens lowered from 12 -> 6, and proto framing added a smallwrite path. suspect extra smallwrite syscalls + re-tokenization.
ashley: do we have flamegraph or perf data? can you paste the hot stack?
maria: yes — run we ran: `./tools/bench_ingress --mode=grpc --streaming --payload short --iters 200` output: 
```
# summary (short payload):
baseline (before PR): tokenization 1.8ms, parse+frame 0.9ms, grpc writev 0.6ms
current (after PR): tokenization 4.0ms, parse+frame 1.2ms, grpc writev 1.1ms
p50 delta: +8ms, p99 delta: +45ms
hot functions: host::tokenize_buffer, host::proto::frame_chunk, sys_writev
```
ben: tokenization jump is suspicious — nothing changed in tokenizer code in that PR afaict. maybe we're triggering a slow path due to different chunk sizes.
kai: that matches: writev fragmentation can increase the number of parse boundaries, which forces tokenizer to handle more short slices and re-run normalization. Also KV cache sees more micro-requests -> cache miss churn.
maria: perf profile (flame): most time in tokenize_buffer -> then parse_slice -> kernel_selector::choose_for_batch (surprising).
ashley: kernel_selector showing up means we might be re-evaluating kernel choices per tiny fragment. cheap fix: memoize kernel selection per request instead of per chunk.
ben: agree. quick repro: instrumented run with env DEBUG_KERNEL_SELECT=1 showed selector called 3x more per request in streaming mode.
kai: also try toggling batching.min_tokens back to 12 in a canary. if latency improves, batching heuristic is the trigger.
maria: plan: 1) revert minibatch hint in canary 2) land memoized kernel selection 3) add pre-tokenization coalescing in grpc smallwrite path to aggregate fragments before tokenize. 4) check KV cache evictions in telemetry.
ben: I can push a quick patch for memoization, small and safe.
ashley: I'll add a telemetry slice for kvcache.evictions and tokenization.calls per request (sampled).
perf-bot: CI run 910110999 -> microbench delta: p50 -2ms (memoize), p99 -20ms (memoize+coalesce) on synthetic short prompts.
kai: nice. one more thought — kernel selection policy currently uses sequence_length only. maybe use combined (seq_len + fragment_count) to avoid flips on micro-fragmentation.
maria: good call. we'll prototype policy change behind a flag. can we schedule a quick canary tonight?
ben: yes, I'll queue a canary image with memoize + batching revert.
ashley: leaving an experiment note in #eng-runtime: "canary: grpc-miniwrite-fix" with steps and metrics to watch (p50/p99 tokenization, kvcache.eviction_rate, syscall writev count).
maria: thanks. if we see improvements, we'll roll forward and add unit tests that simulate fragmented frames. :eyes:
kai: thumbs up. also add a tiny synthetic test that forces 1-byte fragments so we don't regress again.
ben: ack. pushing PR in ~30m. :hammer:
